welcome_message:
🌟 Welcome to Nestly! 🌟

🏠 Nestly is stylish, quality furniture for any interior — from a cozy bedroom to a well-designed living room.

📦 Our catalog includes:
• Bedroom and upholstered furniture
• Kitchen sets
• Tables, chairs, cabinets and dressers
• Wardrobes and closet systems

🛒 How to order:
1️⃣ Choose a furniture category
2️⃣ Browse models and photos
3️⃣ Contact us to place an order

🌍 Products available from Russia and the USA.
🔄 You can return to the main menu anytime.

👇 Choose a category from the menu below:
no_products: No products in this category yet
send_admin_telegram_id: Send the Telegram ID of the user to assign as admin:
invalid_telegram_id: ❌ This doesn't look like a valid Telegram ID (digits only)
user_not_found: ❌ This user hasn't started the bot yet. Ask them to send /start first
choose_parent_category: Choose parent category (or 'No parent' for a top-level category):
must_be_english: ❌ This doesn't look like English. Please try again:
no_leaf_categories: ❌ First create at least one category without subcategories (via /add_category)
choose_product_category: 🛒 Which category should this product go in?
enter_product_description_ru: 📝 Product description in Russian (or tap Skip):
enter_product_description_en: 📝 Product description in English (or tap Skip):
invalid_price: ❌ Enter a valid price (positive number, e.g. 15990):
send_product_photos: 📸 Send product photos (up to 10). When done, tap the button below
max_photos_reached: ❌ Limit of 10 photos reached. Tap the button to finish
at_least_one_photo: ❌ You need to send at least one photo before finishing
product_added: ✅ Product successfully added to the catalog!
application_submitted: ✅ Application submitted! We'll get in touch soon.
choose_user_to_promote: Choose a user to make admin:
application_accepted: 🎉 Your cooperation application has been accepted! We'll be in touch soon.
application_rejected: Unfortunately, your cooperation application has been rejected.
confirm_delete_application: ⚠️ Are you sure you want to delete this application? This cannot be undone.
